# WorkspaceOverlayConfig

> **File:** `config/WorkspaceOverlayConfig.qml` · **Docs:** see [docs/dev](../../README.md)

Reader for the WorkspaceOverlay section (the full-screen workspace overview). Named WorkspaceOverlayConfig because `WorkspaceOverlay` is the shell module type.

### Properties

- `wallpaper` (readonly bool): Cells show the monitor's wallpaper, else `color`
- `color` (readonly color)
- `dimInactive` (readonly real): 0-1: how dark workspaces other than the active one are drawn
- `size` (readonly real): 0-1 of the screen the grid may take
- `backdrop` (readonly real): 0-1 opacity of the backdrop
- `showNumbers` (readonly bool)
- `showTitles` (readonly bool)
- `showHint` (readonly bool)
